_comment: command → providing plugin. Regenerate: python scripts/gen_command_providers.py. Consumed by navig.cli.providers (suggest-and-activate) and the Store's AVAILABLE rows.

android.description: NAVIG Mobile module — pro-grade Android + iOS device operations (a 3uTools for both platforms): connect, device info, apps, file pull, screenshots, backups, plus forensics / spyware-scan / rooting-jailbreak assist / dev-tools / OSINT, and app UI automation, verification & assertions (a11y snapshots, tap/fill, `ui assert` machine checks, evidence capture, replay via agent-device — powers the app-ui-verify Block). Wired into `navig mobile` (+ `navig android` / `navig ios`). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

antivirus.description: NAVIG Antivirus module — browser-extension malware/PUP scanning, Chrome extension-registry auditing, Chrome profile-index recovery, and a system malware scan (Windows Defender; Malwarebytes best-effort). Wired into `navig antivirus`. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

audio.description: NAVIG Audio module — voice (TTS/STT/wake-word/pipeline) + AI audio generation (music/SFX/TTS). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable). Extracted from core navig.voice.

devhost.description: NAVIG Dev Host module — give any local dev server a real .test domain over trusted HTTPS in one command (hosts + mkcert + raw TLS relay), wired into `navig devhost`. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

download.description: Universal media downloader (yt-dlp) — video, audio & files

explore.description: NAVIG Explore module — a universal local media/data explorer for ANY folder. Buckets files by type (image/gif/video/audio/text/document/archive), auto-reads Telegram exports, previews everything, and organizes by drag-to-class. Non-destructive. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).

facebook.description: Manage a Facebook Page — publish, photos, backup

games.description: NAVIG Games — proactively find & auto-claim FREE games (Epic now; GOG/Amazon/Steam next) and manage your game library. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable). FREE-ONLY: never spends real money.
